methodology.timing: Playwright action/readiness plus two animation frames; milliseconds; individual actual observations retained
methodology.statistics: Measured samples exclude warmups; empirical p95 uses nearest rank; unavailable/rejected/timeouts separated from available-only timing summaries
methodology.mixedBaseline: Computed and rejected API timing populations are summarized separately. A mixed BEFORE group can establish its exact computed DTO hash; its failed BEFORE attempts remain explicit, and every AFTER attempt in every planned AFTER measured repetition must compute that same hash. No retry is added or inferred by consolidation
methodology.financialGroupMeaning: Comparison rows are endpoint/action groups, not seven full financial reports. Journal list navigation and search are separate action groups for the same endpoint. Plans/revisions/risk-additions collection DTOs can be empty and are eagerly requested with detail; their equality does not establish a successful main trade-detail DTO or opened immutable history. Main detail and history action failures/skips remain separate
methodology.cache: First measured repetition browser cache disabled; later repetitions cache enabled; database warm after fixture preparation and warmup
methodology.hashes: Exact source SHA-256 and every API requestHash/canonicalHash retained; canonical full JSON sorted by key, omitting only /analytics/context/recordedAt
methodology.comparison: Financial comparisons use measured API attempts, or explicitly marked warmup-only fallback when no measured action exists; absent attempts remain absent. Any BEFORE computed request group must remain computed with its exact canonical hash in every planned AFTER measured repetition; any rejected/missing AFTER attempt fails even if a retry succeeds. Original report comparison rows are retained separately
methodology.capacity: Before rejection/readiness timeout followed by computed after data is not-comparable-before-rejected; capacity gain only, without computed DTO equality or comparable latency claim
methodology.intradayScope: Intraday boundaries apply only to the dashboard POST. Journal list/detail/history still read full current-account history; journal observations must not be described as intraday-bounded reads
methodology.bytes: API jsonBytes is decoded JSON body length; CDP encodedDataLength is received response traffic including protocol/header accounting; ResourceTiming cumulative encoded/decoded/transfer values remain separate
methodology.dom: Element, CDP node and mounted collapsed chart row counts are distinct; snapshots retain open exact-value table counts
methodology.react: Global React root commit census only; no component render duration or component-level browser render count
methodology.tasks: CDP cumulative current-document durations are seconds; observed task/script deltas are milliseconds with document-reset handling; long tasks use PerformanceObserver
methodology.heap: Natural V8 CDP heap snapshots; no forced garbage collection, no browser process RSS, no retained-memory or leak claim; heap differences across navigation are different-document snapshots
methodology.readiness: Client 60-second readiness deadline is not a PostgreSQL timeout; stopped runs retain actual partial/warmup outcomes and explicitly unobserved repetitions
methodology.build: Each formal report retains its actual Next build ID, browser/Node version, viewport and concurrency
methodology.buildIdProvenance: The harness reads apps/web/.next/BUILD_ID from its own working directory. For this evidence campaign every BEFORE harness ran from the same archived checkout as its server and every AFTER harness ran from the same main checkout as its server. Preserve this same-checkout requirement when reproducing: a local BUILD_ID alone does not identify a server reached at an arbitrary origin
methodology.searchCoverage: Search measurements perform one input change only; rapid typing, request cancellation and stale-response behavior are not benchmarked. Zero failed requests would not prove cancellation support
methodology.networkAccounting: Per-action/per-operation counts include all observed same-origin requests, including eager journal history/catalog requests. Exact API JSON bytes are captured only for dashboard reports and journal endpoints; uncaptured catalog JSON lengths remain null. Failed requests remain counted even if a retry succeeds
methodology.captureAccounting: All thirteen action definitions have planned/actual measured and warmup counts. Missing dependent actions and stopped repetitions have explicit reasons; skipped actions are never relabeled measured failures or successful zero-cost interactions
methodology.domRetentionLimit: CDP document/node/listener counts are observed retained counters at natural snapshots; they are not proof of a leak, a retained-size analysis, or a forced-GC verdict
methodology.privacy: Allowlisted evidence only; fixture/scope identity hashed; credentials/private bindings, SQL/bind values, raw financial DTOs, traces and unverified smoke timings excluded
